interpretation.honest: V6 primary hypothesis NOT confirmed on this panel: realized PD recovery confined to 1/12 tasks; interaction direction positive but far from significance at n=12 with 1 nonzero task
interpretation.posthoc_exploratory: A (any FC miss) conflates TRANSIENT misses (000752-F5: varied across reps, PD-recoverable) with PERSISTENT misses (stable across reps and arms, not PD-recoverable). Recoverable failure space appears to be the transient component only. This was NOT preregistered for V6; any future test must preregister A_transient = 1 - P(slot hit | it was missed in a sibling rep) or similar, before data
interpretation.relation_to_V5: consistent with concentration pattern (V5: 3/12 tasks carried 90% of gain); V6 extends it: even within A>0 tasks, only transient-failure tasks yield recoverable space
